name: Okra

schedule.notes: Optional in zones 6 and below. Soak seeds 12 hours first.
Wait for soil 65+ F. Cold soil rots seeds.
Pick every 1 to 2 days — pods get tough fast. Wear long sleeves; spines irritate.

harvest.cues: Pods 3 to 4 in long, firm, snap cleanly. Over-mature pods turn woody and stop production.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in paper bag 3 to 5 days. Slice and freeze, or pickle the small pods whole.

varieties.name: Clemson Spineless
varieties.notes: The classic spineless okra. Easier on the hands.

varieties.name: Burgundy
varieties.notes: Deep red pods (turn green when cooked). Ornamental, equally productive.

notes: Loves heat. Plants get 5 to 8 ft tall — give them space. Pick under-ripe pods religiously; one over-mature pod halts the whole branch.
